title: Snake Classic
---
Build a classic snake game in the browser: a grid board, arrow-key controls, growing snake, food spawns, game over on wall or self collision, and a high score kept in localStorage across sessions.
emma:
- Grid board where the snake moves continuously in four directions
- Arrow-key controls; snake cannot reverse into itself
- Food spawns at random empty cells; eating grows the snake and adds score
- Game over on wall or self collision, with a restart option
- Current score and high score displayed during play
- High score saved in localStorage and persists across sessions
- Clean, minimal look: dark board, bright snake and food, monospace score text
